question: Counting 776 BC as the first Olympiad and one every four years, which Olympiad fell in AD 393, given no year zero?
move: When counting events across a span, check both ends of the fence.
trap: Dividing the span by four and forgetting the first Games themselves.
hint: Count the years between, then the four-year gaps, then the Games.
steps: With no year zero, 776 BC to AD 393 spans 776 + 393 − 1 = 1,168 years.
1,168 ÷ 4 = 292 four-year gaps after the first Games.
source: Bickerman, Chronology of the Ancient World
reference: Bickerman, Chronology of the Ancient World, Thames and Hudson, 1968
